# `scene.set_transform`: Set transform

Sets or adjusts an object's position, rotation (degrees) and scale relative to its parent.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(depth)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: move, rotate, scale, translate, grab, set position

Only the given parts change. Rotation is Euler degrees about X, then Y, then Z. With `relative: true`, position is added, rotation applied on top and scale multiplied. Mesh data does not change; see `scene.apply_transform` to bake it in.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length] \| null` | `null` | Position in the parent's space. |
| `relative` | `boolean` | `false` | Add to the position, rotate further and multiply the scale instead of replacing them. |
| `rotation` | `[Angle, Angle, Angle] \| null` | `null` | Euler angles in degrees, applied about X, then Y, then Z. |
| `scale` | `Scale \| null` | `null` | Uniform factor or per-axis factors. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object to move (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"rotation":[0,45,0],"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): position 0 0 0, rotation 0 45 0 deg, scale 1 1 1`
